title: IntentAnalyzeRequest
description: A single normalized message and working-context snapshot sent to AI to decide what the sender wants, as distinct from whether to interrupt. Carries the current instant because a language model cannot know it and will otherwise invent one.

now.description: The instant the request is made, with an explicit offset. REQUIRED, and the one field callers forget. A model has no clock: asked to resolve a relative expression such as a weekday or 'the day after tomorrow' without it, it will pick a plausible date and be confidently wrong. The offset also fixes which local day the message refers to.

metadata.description: Optional normalized extension fields. Do not include raw provider API objects or credentials.
